scope: DL1 staged SOIC-to-DIP logic conversion of the reference FD1 netlist. Pin/net/footprint checks only; integrated timing and physical qualification pending. Owned-memory architecture changes are separate.

CD74HCT154M96.sourcing: Historical PDIP listing only; absent from current TI orderable addendum. Obtain verified old stock or redesign using DIP decoders; unresolved purchasing item.

CD74HCT161M96.sourcing: Owned HCT161 family; exact CD74HCT161E ownership not established.

CD74HCT377M96.sourcing: Owned HCT377 family; exact CD74HCT377E ownership not established.

act175_limits.document: SCHS345A, May 2024, pages 3-9 and orderable addendum
act175_limits.conditions: 4.5..5.5 V, -55..125 C, CL=50 pF; test edges 3 ns. Operating input transition limit 10 ns/V.
act175_limits.scope: Reviewed component limits, not a promoted system timing model. Recompute hold, clear/recovery, clock receiver thresholds, loaded edges and supply current. AC175 analogue results cannot be inherited.

decision.selected: Pin-compatible ACT175 DIP conversion before register consolidation
alternatives: HCT574 register redesign with new reset/inverted-output logic
Eight-bit resettable 273 registers after clock/reset grouping and rewiring
decision.rationale: ACT175 preserves asynchronous reset and both output polarities used in the netlist, with current manufacturer PDIP evidence. HCT574 is owned but has no reset and no complementary outputs.
decision.jev: Guidance skill unavailable; no Jev MCP interface/resources exposed. Continued with datasheet and netlist evidence; no advisory result claimed.
